shows.title: Blade Runner 2099
shows.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

shows.title: Fool Night
shows.overview: In a sunless future where humans become plants to make oxygen, a desperate young man begins the transformation — and unearths a deep-rooted conspiracy.

shows.title: The Hunting Wives
shows.overview: Sophie trades New England for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

shows.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
shows.overview: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

shows.title: Dexter: Resurrection
shows.overview: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

shows.title: Sweetpea
shows.overview: Rhiannon Lewis doesn't make much of an impression - people walk past her in the street without a second glance. That is until she is pushed over the edge and loses control. Rhiannon's life transforms, but can she keep her killer secret?

shows.title: Always on Call
shows.overview: A devoted team of medical professionals navigate personal struggles, political pressure and a risky new hire at an overwhelmed emergency room in Oslo.

shows.title: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping
shows.overview: 1982. When the matriarch of a Dutch hotel empire is kidnapped for ransom, her family launches a desperate effort to free her.

shows.title: MobLand
shows.overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

shows.title: Nine to Six
shows.overview: Falsely blamed for a car fire, Chronic Motors Senior Manager Kang Yi-ji faces demotion. Can she find love and happiness amid office politics?
